name: War Room
summary: Commanders gather inside Stormwind Keep to plan the Alliance’s defense. The War Room holds weapons, records, and charts for that work.

sections.title: Nerve Center of the Keep
sections.body:
Beyond Stormwind Keep’s grand chambers, commanders plan campaigns and arrange military supplies. Swords, blunderbusses, and heavy artillery cannons line the stone walls. Nearby tables hold military treatises and chronicles of past wars.

At the center, a large map shows Alliance deployments across Azeroth. The royal court handles affairs of state just steps away.

faq.q: Where is the War Room located?
faq.answer: Deep inside Stormwind Keep, beyond its central corridors, the War Room holds heavy fortifications, weapon racks, and a large tactical map table.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this room?
aliases: why does the keep have a war room
faq.answer: Within Stormwind, Alliance commanders use the War Room to review intelligence, coordinate troop movements, and study conflicts past and present.

faq.q: What historical lore can be found here?
faq.answer: The tables hold books on military strategy and chronicles of the kingdom’s past wars, close at hand as commanders plan Alliance campaigns.

angles.text: As an Alliance soldier or champion, you can look to the War Room for plans to defend the realm from lingering threats across the Eastern Kingdoms and beyond.
As a warrior, you may value the military order inside Stormwind Keep, among its heavy munitions and strategic maps.
